ownership: Official published Business Entity Data File Formats company-family layout; no source data is bundled.
allowed_use: offline inspection of an explicitly operator-supplied authorized package
prohibited_use: emitting registered-agent, applicant, parent-company, or other person-bearing fields
representing a principal office as a physical operating site
representing registry status as verified current operation
source authenticity or statewide completeness claims
attribution: Source layout: Kentucky Secretary of State Business Entity Data File Formats.
retention: Raw company-family files are person-bearing and internal. Normalized projections remain local-review-only pending an executed rights and retention review.
personal_data_handling: Immediately discard registered-agent/address and applicant/title fields. Obsolete finance/share fields are also discarded, and officer files are not accepted. Principal-office fields are retained only as administrative evidence and may be residential or outside Kentucky.
